messages:
Maya (Sales): ACME risk team requested a focused BCP/DR proof pack for their vendor review. They want RTO/RPO by tier, backup cadence + retention, recent failover test evidence, and the SLA credit model. Can we assemble today?
Diego (Solutions): I can compile a one-page summary + artifacts. Do they need signed attestation or is an internal sign-off OK?
Maya (Sales): They asked for 'committee-grade' evidence. Prefer signed attestation if possible.
Priya (SRE): Quick facts I can include:
```
- Hosted API: Uptime SLA 99.95%; typical RTO (control plane) = 5m; RTO (model serving failover) = 15m; RPO <= 60s for customer requests when KV caching allowed.
- Dedicated: Baseline 99.95%, failover time 15-30m depending on pool and network; RPO target 1-5m depending on replication config.
- Private: Operational SLAs depend on customer infra; we provide runbook and integration checklist.
- Backups: metadata snapshot daily, continuous incremental ledger for customer data; default retention 90d; extended retention available by contract.
- DR tests: quarterly; last executed 2025-03-12; artifacts: logs + signed postmortem.
```
Priya (SRE): I'll export the test logs, backup job history, and an anonymized 12mo availability CSV.
Ralph (Security): We'll need the change ticket IDs and sign-off block in the attestation. Also include KMS rotation cadence and confirmation of encryption at rest/in transit. I can sign the attestation when draft is ready.
Maya (Sales): ACME specifically called out wanting to witness a failover during the POC if possible. Can we offer that?
Diego (Solutions): Yes — POC offer: schedule a controlled failover window, we run detection -> pool drain -> promote replica, capture metrics (latency, error-rate, warmup times), provide replay + signed postmortem.
Priya (SRE): I'll propose a constrained run: non-peak window, can limit to a single model variant to minimize customer impact. We can show KV warmup timeline and routing fallback.
Maya (Sales): Good. Also they want the SLA credit calculation and sample credits for a 2h outage.
Priya (SRE): SLA credits summary: credit = min(50% of monthly invoice, tiered percentage of monthly fee) based on downtime bands; I'll paste the legal-friendly wording into the bundle. I'll also add an example calc for 2h on a monthly bill.
Diego (Solutions): Checklist I'm assembling:
- One-page RTO/RPO + backup summary
- DR runbook (pdf)
- Failover test logs + signed postmortem
- Change ticket refs + sign-off
- KMS/HSM integration note
- SLA doc + sample credit calc + availability CSV (12mo anonymized)
- Offer: POC failover demo slot

Diego (Solutions): I'll stitch to a single package and produce a pre-signed link for sharing.
Ralph (Security): Draft attestation uploaded to our internal bucket for review. Please ensure wording includes: 'Redwood Ops performed and signed the March 12, 2025 DR exercise; evidence attached; encryption keys under customer KMS if requested; production-level backups executed daily.' I'll sign after wording check.
evidence-bot: Note: Uploaded artifacts scanned. Result: no secrets found; files marked sanitized.
Priya (SRE): Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-evidence/bcp/ACME/2025-03-12/ (failover-logs.csv, backup-history.json, postmortem-signed.pdf, uptime-12mo-anon.csv). Also included the sanitized run command snippet used during test:
```
# sanitized run snippet
redwoodctl drain --pool=hosting-prod --grace=20s
redwoodctl promote --replica=standby-01
monitoring export --metric=p95_latency --from=2025-03-12T02:00Z --to=2025-03-12T03:00Z > p95.csv
```
Diego (Solutions): Draft bundle link (internal): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/bcp/ACME/2025-03-12/proofpack-1851123999.zip (will replace with pre-signed link for customer)
Maya (Sales): Ralph, can you sign the attestation by EOD? Diego, please swap to a customer pre-signed URL when ready and I'll email ACME with the POC failover slot options.
Ralph (Security): Signing now. Uploaded signed_attestation.pdf to same folder.
Priya (SRE): Added anonymized monthly availability CSV and a short note on measurement method (monitoring health pings + traffic-weighted availability).
Maya (Sales): Sending to ACME now with POC options. Will update thread if they request deeper per-endpoint RPO proofs. Thanks team :rocket:
